title: Meet Opal, your RunFloor guide
body: Hi, I’m Opal! I help you find your way around RunFloor using verified platform guides. My help is included and never uses dealership AI credits. I cannot read dealership activity, change records, or send messages. If I cannot verify an answer, I will say so.
steps: Select Ask Opal from any workspace page.
Describe what you are trying to do, or choose Help with this page.
Follow a linked guide for the full instructions.
Use Contact support to prepare an email to support@runfloorai.com.
summary: Hi, I’m Opal! I help you find your way around RunFloor using verified platform guides.

title: Find your way around RunFloor
body: Home is your starting point. Sales, Operations, and Executive group related tools. Available tools depend on your access.
steps: Open the navigation menu if it is hidden.
Expand Sales, Operations, or Executive to find its tools.
Select Home to return to the dashboard.
Open Help Center or Ask Opal whenever you need guidance.

title: Ask the Sales AI Assistant
body: The Sales AI Assistant provides a conversation for sales questions. Include the model, year, and customer needs in your question. Opal can explain how to use it; Opal does not read its conversations.
steps: Open Sales → Sales AI Assistant.
Type your question or choose a suggested prompt.
Select Send message.
Review the answer and supporting sources before using it.
summary: The Sales AI Assistant provides a conversation for sales questions.

title: Find an RV in your inventory
body: Use the inventory library to find published models and open their product guides. A catalog listing alone does not establish current stock availability.
steps: Open Sales → RVs & Inventory.
Use Search inventory and narrow by brand, RV type, or model year.
Select View product guide to read model details.
Use Clear to remove filters when a model is missing.
summary: Use the inventory library to find published models and open their product guides.

title: Compare RV models
body: Compare the available product specifications side by side. Not provided means a value is missing; it does not prove the vehicle lacks a feature.
steps: Open Sales → Product Comparisons.
Choose Our Product and Competitor Product.
Optionally select Add a third product.
Check the model years and open product guides to confirm important details.
summary: Compare the available product specifications side by side.

title: Prepare a customer email or text
body: Message Center helps prepare customer messages using AI or approved templates. Review the preview before copying a message into your sending tool.
steps: Open Sales → Message Center.
Choose Email or Text message.
Choose Generate with AI or Use a template.
Complete customer and product context, then generate or choose a template.
Review the preview and use Copy or Print.
summary: Message Center helps prepare customer messages using AI or approved templates.

title: Find a procedure
body: The procedure library groups processes by category. Check the status and version before treating a procedure as approved guidance.
steps: Open Operations → Procedures.
Search procedures or choose a category.
Select Open procedure.
Check Draft or Published status and the displayed version.
summary: The procedure library groups processes by category.

title: Use the Operations calendar
body: The calendar combines dated checklists, alerts, and recurring schedule runs. Employee calendar sync and notifications are not connected in this version.
steps: Open Operations → Task Calendar.
Use Previous month, Next month, or Today.
Narrow by Location or Work type.
If the month is empty, check filters and try another month.
summary: The calendar combines dated checklists, alerts, and recurring schedule runs.

title: Understand Historical Trends
body: Historical Trends uses approved monthly results. Draft and missing records are excluded; missing months are not estimated.
steps: Open Executive → Historical Trends.
Choose 6, 12, or 24 months, or a custom range.
Select the available location filter and Apply filters.
If a month is missing, ask an administrator to check approval of its sales results.
summary: Historical Trends uses approved monthly results.

title: Complete a Monthly Leadership Review
body: Both completion buttons save the current notes and record review completion. Clear changes the notes field locally until the form is submitted. Notes allow up to 2,000 characters.
steps: Open Executive → Monthly Review.
Select the reporting period and View period.
Review the snapshot, agenda, accountability, and decisions.
Enter your Review Notes.
Select Save notes and complete review or Mark review complete.
summary: Both completion buttons save the current notes and record review completion.

title: Understand Priority Scoring
body: Priority scores are planning aids, not predictions. Higher impact, confidence, and alignment increase priority; lower effort, cost, and risk increase priority.
steps: Open Executive → Priority Scoring.
Filter or sort the ranked opportunities.
Use View details to review the underlying ratings.
Expand How the priority score is calculated to see the explanation.
summary: Priority scores are planning aids, not predictions.

title: Upload dealership knowledge
body: Administrators can upload PDF, DOCX, Markdown, or text documents up to 4 MiB. Processing can succeed or fail; uploading alone is not a guarantee that content is usable by every assistant.
steps: Open Knowledge Base.
Enter a Title and select a Collection.
Optionally associate a product and location from the current dealership.
Choose the file and select Upload securely.
Review processing status and any error.
summary: Administrators can upload PDF, DOCX, Markdown, or text documents up to 4 MiB.

title: Understand shared AI credits
body: AI Usage & Billing shows included credits, pending reservations, purchased credits, and usage history. Opal’s platform help never deducts dealership credits.
steps: Open AI Usage & Billing.
Review the displayed period and remaining balance.
Check Reserved / pending when comparing available credits with completed usage.
Use Company usage history filters and select Filter.
summary: AI Usage & Billing shows included credits, pending reservations, purchased credits, and usage history.

title: Contact RunFloor support
body: Need extra help? Email support@runfloorai.com. Contact support prepares a draft for you to review and send; it does not send automatically.
steps: Select Contact support in the Help Center or Opal panel.
Describe what you tried and what happened.
Choose whether to include the Opal conversation.
Review the email draft and send it from your email app.
